t: Flomasta PipeGrip Reducing Tee is a push-fit water pipe fitting that reduces 22mm pipe to 15mm in a T-shaped branch. Its dual locking system and green band indicator ensure a secure, leak-free connection with no tools or hot works needed. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, it’s the ideal solution for compact spaces and branching pipework.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
No Hot Works: Quick & Safe Installation
